heading: About
lead: I am an undergraduate researcher at IIIT Hyderabad working at the intersection of robotics, computer vision, and language systems.
bio: I'm an undergraduate researcher at the [Robotics Research Center](https://robotics.iiit.ac.in/), [IIIT Hyderabad](https://www.iiit.ac.in/), where I work with Prof. Sourav Garg on visual navigation and embodied perception. I'm pursuing a BTech + MS in Electronics and Communication Engineering.
Previously, I was a research intern at TCS Research, working on reinforcement learning for human–AI co-creation, and at IIT Bombay with Prof. Vikram Bansal, on transformer-based crowd counting.
Outside research I like building systems from the ground up — an LLM routing pipeline, a relational database engine, and a pipelined RISC-V processor, among others.
motivation: I am drawn to problems where a system has to commit to a decision under genuine uncertainty about the world — a robot that must move before it has mapped the room, a router that must choose a model before it has seen the answer. The engineering and the theory stay honest there.
